en-US.description: Keep a chosen window visible to you but hidden from screen-share viewers and recordings.
en-US.longDescription:
Hushglass protects a window you choose from screen capture on Windows. The window stays
open, visible and fully usable on your own screen, while anyone watching a screen share
or a recording sees an opaque privacy screen reading "Private content protected" where
it was.

Protection has been tested from the viewer's side against Google Meet, Zoom, Microsoft
Teams desktop, OBS Display Capture, ShareX, Clipchamp and the Windows Snipping Tool.
Hushglass hides its own window as well, so viewers never see the control panel or the
list of protected windows.

Two limits are worth knowing before installing. Protection applies when you share your
entire screen; sharing the protected window itself as a single window is not supported.
And hardware capture, such as pointing a phone camera at the monitor, can still see the
screen.

Free protects one window. Pro adds unlimited windows and automatic protection for
pop-up windows opened by an app that is already protected. One licence covers two
computers.

Requires Windows 10 version 2004 or later. Installs for the current user only and
raises no administrator prompt.
en-US.name: Hushglass
